run_linear_scan: run lru_linear_scan to compute a linear scan over the second axis of input sequences with optional reverse and accumulation dtype
run_associative_scan: run lru_associative_scan to compute an associative scan over the second axis of input sequences for parallel recurrence
run_single_shard_rnn_scan: run single_shard_rnn_scan to execute a linear RNN recurrence on a single sequence shard with configurable scan type
run_linear_scan_with_sharding: run linear_scan with a ShardingSpec to execute RNN recurrence under pjit with distributed sharding across devices
resolve_scan_type: resolve_scan_type to auto-select LINEAR_PALLAS on TPU or LINEAR_NATIVE on other platforms
